newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht higher late, interbank rate eases.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht higher late, interbank rate eases.

text.p: The Thai baht was higher against the dollar in late trade on Thursday as the U.S. unit's slightly weakened abroad, dealers said.
The baht edged up to 25.947/25.957 to the dollar late from 25.960/25.965 earlier, dealers said.
But some persistent demand for the dollar helped support the greenback from further downside against the baht, dealers said.
"The dollar did not fall as much as it has to be. Some offshore players continued to cover their dollar position ahead of the weakend," one dealer at a foreign bank said.
The foreign exchange and money markets will be closed on Monday for a public holiday.
The overnight interbank rate eased to 8.50-9.00 percent late from 9.50-10.00 earlier on rising liquidity, dealers said.
"Most banks appeared to maintain sufficient funds to meet the reserve requirement due tomorrow. The interbank rate is likely to soften further tomorrow," said one money market dealer.
All commercial banks have to meet the Bank of Thailand's reserve requirement on seventh and 22nd of each month.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium dipped to 6.50/7.50 satangs per dollar late from 7.00/7.50 earlier.
